title: Molting Pattern
rules_text: The scales are gone. Embermaw opens Phase II by punishing an unheld front and burning the ground it stood on.

instant_beats.title: Rending Claw
instant_beats.rules_text: Target: Tank. Deal 6 damage. Movement does not evade this hit. An unheld Guarded Front suffers +5.

instant_beats.title: Ash Trail
instant_beats.rules_text: The struck front arc becomes Scorched, and stays for two Rounds.

incoming_beats.title: Brood Call
incoming_beats.rules_text: Three Whelps emerge at the marked edge hexes.

incoming_beats.title: Close the Lanes
incoming_beats.rules_text: Resolve the cone before Whelps close routes.
